kind: stdlib process engineering acceptance; no model, training, datasets or scientific rerun
platform: Windows only; unsupported platforms fail closed and do not count as Windows validation
launch_path: Use the explicitly supplied existing activation-venv/Scripts/python.exe path with -S and this probe; preserve launcher PID and actual interpreter PID separately.
identity_gate: CreateProcessW suspended launcher; assign non-breakaway Windows JobObject with KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE before ResumeThread. Child sends a fresh 256-bit nonce, self PID, parent PID, creation FILETIME and self-memory. Retain native process handles for launcher, interpreter and descendant. Verify creation times and live job membership; Toolhelp parent chain must reach retained launcher (or identity if no redirector). Fail closed on inability to assign/query/verify. No launcher-memory substitution.
synchronization: Child waits at explicit barriers without modifying allocations. For each memory checkpoint, child emits self-before, parent queries the retained actual-interpreter handle, child emits self-after. Parent reading must lie within the self bracket plus the fixed 4MiB tolerance for resident/private bytes; identity/creation FILETIME must match. Preserve all three readings, monotonic timestamps and comparison outcomes.

cases_in_order.expected: Correct interpreter identity, matching baseline/allocated bracket readings, resident AND private delta >=24MiB, normal worker+descendant completion before deadline; same containment and deadlines as failure cases without false termination.
Uncapped negative control permits 64MiB touched allocation; resident AND private delta >=56MiB, correct identity/brackets, worker+descendant normal completion.

At baseline actual-interpreter private bytes +48MiB, parent observes retained actual-interpreter handle crossing cap after a held 64MiB allocation, records memory_private_limit rather than timeout, terminates the JobObject within1s of allocation-ready receipt, and verifies worker, launcher and descendant handles exited and job active count zero.

Worker and descendant deliberately stall after verified barrier; no early timeout during identity/memory checks. At1.5s deadline parent records timeout and terminates whole JobObject; all retained handles exit and job active count becomes zero within4s.

Worker and descendant stall after verified barrier; closing sole noninherited JobObject handle invokes KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE without TerminateJobObject. All retained launcher/interpreter/descendant handles exit within4s; no active-count query is claimed after close.

allocation: stdlib ctypes VirtualAlloc reserve+commit, touch every committed page, retain until explicitly released/terminated. Main worker explicit allocations never exceed64MiB; descendant allocates no diagnostic payload. Imports/runtime/OS overhead is separate.
containment: Windows JobObject inheritance, no BREAKAWAY_OK/SILENT_BREAKAWAY_OK and no inherited job handle. Suspend/assign/resume prevents the venv redirector from spawning before assignment. Descendant handshake is separately authenticated and its creation time/job membership/ancestry verified before controls. Linux process groups are not a fallback or evidence for Windows.
cap_interpretation: This tests sampled parent enforcement of a private-byte threshold on the correct interpreter plus whole-job termination. It is not a kernel hard memory ceiling, continuous observation, peak-private measurement, arbitrary descendant memory cap, adversarial escape proof or zero-overshoot guarantee. The controlled64MiB allocation may overshoot a48MiB increment before20ms polling observes it. No job hard-memory-limit success claim is made.
acceptance: All five fixed cases and every stated identity, synchronization, allocation, expected-reason and cleanup gate must pass. Record every case, samples and negative result; no replacement, skipped-case pass, fallback, threshold changes or rerun. An infrastructure failure is a failed engineering gate. Unit/mock tests are separate and cannot count as acceptance.
freeze_and_execution: Root reviews protocol and implementation/unit tests, writes implementation freeze including exact protocol/source hashes, then launches this acceptance once into a fresh output directory. Probe verifies freeze before spawning. This subtask implements and runs mock/unit tests only; no real process acceptance before freeze.
reporting: Publish nonce-bound identities/ancestry/creation FILETIMEs, self-parent-self readings, all cap samples, elapsed/reason, termination path/exit statuses and failures. Keep local absolute launch paths out of public receipts (publish basename+file SHA256); do not claim earlier activation-cost RSS repaired. All historical frozen code/results remain unchanged.
boundaries: No model imports/downloads, holdout reads, training, paid APIs or external communication.
Windows one-host controlled engineering evidence only; not a future training-cost result.
No integration into the old frozen probes or package API in this pass.
